Welcome to 1Kosmos Digital Bank

Open your account securely in minutes. Identity verification takes approximately 3 minutes.

Selfie & Liveness

Government ID

Account Setup

Privacy & Consent

Before we begin, please review how we use your information.

  • ✓

    Your biometric data is used solely for identity verification and is never sold or shared.

  • ✓

    We comply with GDPR, CCPA, GLBA, and applicable banking privacy regulations.

  • ✓

    All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).

  • ✓

    You may request deletion of your biometric data at any time via account settings.

{form-buttons-placeholder}

Secured by

Camera Check

We need to verify your camera meets our quality requirements for identity verification.

Please allow camera access to proceed with biometric identity verification. Your video is never recorded or stored.
